test_title: SSC CHSL (2022) Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 26 Jun, 2023 Shift 1).
subject: general
question:
Which of the following statements is/are correct regarding the Arya Samaj and Swami Dayanand Saraswati?

**Statement A:** The original name of Swami Dayanand Saraswati was Mool Shankar Tiwari.

**Statement B**: Swami Dayanand Saraswati was a native of Gujarat.

**Statement C**: The Arya Samaj was founded in the year 1875.

options.text: All of A, B and C

solution:
The correct answer is __**All of A, B and C.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Swami Dayanand Saraswati **was born as **Mool Shankar Tiwari **in the town of** Tankara in the Morbi district of Gujarat, India**. ***Hence. Statement A and B are correct.***
 
• He** left his home** at the age of** 21 **and wandered for around **25 years across India **in search of **religious truth **before he became **"Dayanand",** a monk or sannyasi.
 
• He is known as the **founder of the Arya Samaj,** a Hindu reform movement, which was **established in Bombay in 1875**. ***Hence, Statement C is also correct.***
 
• The main purpose of founding Arya Samaj was to bring **changes in the Hindu society. **He propagated for the return to the teachings of the **ancient Vedas, thus rejecting idol worship, animal sacrifice, and temple offerings**.
 
• Swami Dayanand Saraswati is considered a** prominent figure** in the context of** India's socio-religious reform movements.** His philosophy and vision have significantly impacted the cultural and religious landscape of modern India.
 
• His reformist ideology had also a significant impact on champions of the Indian Independence movement such as** Lala Lajpat Rai and Bhagat Singh,** who were also **members of Arya Samaj**.
